extensions.platform: Avalonia 12 XAML (Fluent), Windows desktop. Recorded as `web` only because Impeccable has no desktop value: there is no browser and no CSS. Tokens live in src/UpdateManager.App/App.axaml (ThemeDictionaries Light/Dark + static stage brushes + Fluent resource-key overrides); font Golos Text set as default in Program.cs. Component snippets below are Avalonia XAML: `xaml` is the markup as used in Views/*.axaml, `styles` is the App.axaml style it depends on.

stockChrome.name: focus-visual-primary
stockChrome.purpose: Keyboard focus ring: 2px Ink outline (Fluent default thickness), square.

stockChrome.name: focus-visual-secondary
stockChrome.purpose: 1px Ground gap inside the focus ring.

stockChrome.name: scrollbar-thumb
stockChrome.purpose: Scrollbar thumb at rest (Pending Grey); square via `ScrollBar /template/ Thumb` CornerRadius 0.

stockChrome.name: scrollbar-track
stockChrome.purpose: Expanded scrollbar track; collapsed to Fluent's thin line until hovered.

stockChrome.name: corner-radius
stockChrome.purpose: Square corners on every stock Fluent control: inputs, menus, tooltips, combo boxes.

stockChrome.name: fluent-accent
stockChrome.purpose: Build Blue as the Fluent accent for inputs, checkboxes and text selection; the one place a stage hue appears outside stage blocks.

stockChrome.name: region
stockChrome.purpose: Fluent region colour matches the Matte Ground.

display.purpose: Selected release version number; one per screen.

headline.purpose: Featured recent project name; empty states «Первый проект» / «Первый выпуск».

title.purpose: Project name at the top of the catalog panel; dialog headings (`TextBlock.heading`, red via `.failed` only for an error message).

title-sm.purpose: Stage block titles, recent project names, primary button label.

body.purpose: Status line, metadata beside the version, table values, dialog message text.

detail.purpose: Paths, catalog second line, stage block detail, dialog help and derived values under an input (`TextBlock.detail`).

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked list headers in the left panel only (`TextBlock.caps`).

motion.name: none
motion.purpose: The Still Catalog Rule: no transitions or animations are authored; state changes are instant. Only Fluent's own control feedback (scrollbar expand, indeterminate progress bar) moves.

states.name: recent-missing
states.purpose: Recent project whose folder no longer exists.

states.name: failed-stroke
states.purpose: Only heavy stroke in the system: failed stage block, failed chip, and the dialog failure box.

breakpoints.name: stage-strip-wrap
breakpoints.value: 150px min block width; below it the strip goes two per row

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single filled ink button that names the next step; one per screen or dialog footer.
components.styles:
<Style Selector="Button"><Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="0" /></Style>
<Style Selector="Button.primary"><Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource InkBrush}" /><Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource InkInverseBrush}" /><Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold" /><Setter Property="FontSize" Value="15" /><Setter Property="Padding" Value="22,11" /><Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0" /></Style>
<Style Selector="Button.primary:pointerover /template/ ContentPresenter#PART_ContentPresenter"><Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.86" /></Style>
<Style Selector="Button.primary:pressed /template/ ContentPresenter#PART_ContentPresenter"><Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.72" /></Style>

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Hairline-outlined secondary action: table actions, pickers, footer Отмена/Нет, alternatives beside the primary (16,10 padding there).
components.styles:
<Style Selector="Button.quiet"><Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent" /><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource HairlineBrush}" /><Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1" /><Setter Property="Padding" Value="12,5" /></Style>
<Style Selector="Button.quiet:pointerover /template/ ContentPresenter#PART_ContentPresenter"><Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource SelectedBrush}" /><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource PendingBrush}" /></Style>
<Style Selector="Button.quiet:disabled /template/ ContentPresenter#PART_ContentPresenter"><Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent" /><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource HairlineBrush}" /><Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource PendingBrush}" /></Style>

components.name: Stage Block
components.description: Signature component: square block, min 112px, 12x14 padding; fill = done, 1px Pending outline = not yet, 2px Failure Red outline = failed. Actionable blocks wrap in Button.stagebtn with an underlined action line. Laid out by StageGrid (6px gap, 150px min cell).
components.xaml:
<Button Classes="stagebtn">
  <Border Classes="stage done build" MinHeight="112" Padding="14,12">
    <DockPanel>
      <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Classes="stageaction" Margin="0,8,0,0" Text="Сменить папку билда" />
      <StackPanel Spacing="6">
        <TextBlock FontSize="15" FontWeight="SemiBold" Text="Билд" />
        <TextBlock Classes="number" FontSize="12" TextWrapping="Wrap" MaxLines="3" Text="скопирован 27.10.2026 20:41" />
      </StackPanel>
    </DockPanel>
  </Border>
</Button>
components.styles:
<Style Selector="Border.stage"><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource PendingBrush}" /><Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1" /><Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent" /><Setter Property="TextElement.Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource MutedBrush}" /></Style>
<Style Selector="Border.stage.done"><Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0" /><Setter Property="TextElement.Foreground" Value="{StaticResource StageInkBrush}" /></Style>
<Style Selector="Border.stage.done.build"><Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource StageBuildBrush}" /></Style>
<Style Selector="Border.stage.failed"><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource FailedBrush}" /><Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="2" /><Setter Property="TextElement.Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource FailedBrush}" /></Style>
<Style Selector="Button.stagebtn:pointerover Border.stage"><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource InkBrush}" /></Style>
<Style Selector="Button.stagebtn:pointerover Border.stage.done"><Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.88" /></Style>
<Style Selector="Button.stagebtn:pressed Border.stage"><Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.74" /></Style>
<Style Selector="TextBlock.stageaction"><Setter Property="FontSize" Value="12" /><Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold" /><Setter Property="TextDecorations" Value="Underline" /></Style>

components.name: Catalog Row
components.description: Release entry in the left panel: version (Entry, tabular), state in words, 14x8 stage chips 3px apart; hairline top border; hover and selection are a Selected Grey fill, no accent bar.
components.xaml:
<ListBox Classes="catalog" ItemsSource="{Binding Releases}">
  <!-- item -->
  <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
    <StackPanel Spacing="1">
      <TextBlock Classes="number" FontSize="15" Text="2.0.0.0" />
      <TextBlock Classes="muted number" FontSize="12" Text="№ 5 · проверка не прошла" />
    </StackPanel>
    <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="3" Margin="8,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center">
      <Border Classes="chip done build" />
      <Border Classes="chip done patch" />
      <Border Classes="chip done delivery" />
      <Border Classes="chip failed" />
    </StackPanel>
  </Grid>
</ListBox>
components.styles:
<Style Selector="ListBox.catalog"><Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent" /><Setter Property="Padding" Value="0" /></Style>
<Style Selector="ListBox.catalog ListBoxItem"><Setter Property="Padding" Value="20,11" /><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource HairlineBrush}" /><Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0,1,0,0" /></Style>
<Style Selector="ListBox.catalog ListBoxItem:pointerover /template/ ContentPresenter#PART_ContentPresenter"><Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource SelectedBrush}" /></Style>
<Style Selector="ListBox.catalog ListBoxItem:selected /template/ ContentPresenter#PART_ContentPresenter"><Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource SelectedBrush}" /><Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource InkBrush}" /></Style>
<Style Selector="Border.chip"><Setter Property="Width" Value="14" /><Setter Property="Height" Value="8" /><Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1" /><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource PendingBrush}" /></Style>
<Style Selector="Border.chip.done"><Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0" /></Style>
<Style Selector="Border.chip.failed"><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource FailedBrush}" /><Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="2" /></Style>

components.name: Version Heading
components.description: The one big number, with platform and release number beside it on the baseline in muted body text.
components.xaml:
<StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
  <TextBlock Classes="number" FontSize="72" LetterSpacing="-2" Margin="0,0,20,0" Text="2.0.0.0" />
  <TextBlock Classes="muted" FontSize="14" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" Margin="0,0,0,14" Text="Windows · выпуск 5" />
</StackPanel>
components.styles:
<Style Selector="TextBlock.number"><Setter Property="FontFeatures" Value="+tnum" /></Style>
<Style Selector="TextBlock.muted"><Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource MutedBrush}" /></Style>

components.name: Info Table Row
components.description: Label / value / action row under a hairline: columns 150 / * / 128, 11px vertical padding, path ellipsis with full-text tooltip.
components.xaml:
<Grid ColumnDefinitions="150,*,128" Margin="0,11">
  <TextBlock Classes="muted" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Папка билда" />
  <TextBlock Grid.Column="1" TextTrimming="PathSegmentEllipsis" ToolTip.Tip="C:\Users\…\Release" Text="C:\Users\…\Release" />
  <Button Grid.Column="2" Classes="quiet" Content="Выбрать…" />
</Grid>
components.styles: <Style Selector="Button.quiet"><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource HairlineBrush}" /><Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1" /><Setter Property="Padding" Value="12,5" /></Style>

components.name: Dialog Footer
components.description: Panel Grey band under a hairline, 24x14 padding; one primary naming the action then quiet Отмена/Нет (16x10, min width 96), right-aligned; an optional quiet tool action sits on the left.

<Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Classes="footer">
  <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*,Auto">
    <Button Classes="quiet" Content="Проверить соединение" />
    <StackPanel Grid.Column="2" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="10">
      <Button Classes="primary" Content="Сохранить" IsDefault="True" />
      <Button Classes="quiet" Content="Отмена" IsCancel="True" />
    </StackPanel>
  </Grid>
</Border>
components.styles:
<Style Selector="Border.footer"><Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource PanelBrush}" /><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource HairlineBrush}" /><Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0,1,0,0" /><Setter Property="Padding" Value="24,14" /></Style>
<Style Selector="Border.footer Button"><Setter Property="MinWidth" Value="96" /><Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Center" /></Style>
<Style Selector="Border.footer Button.quiet"><Setter Property="Padding" Value="16,10" /></Style>

components.name: Dialog Field Row and Section
components.description: Dialog body (inset 24, 22 top): Title heading, muted field label in a 140-170px column, stock square input, 10px row spacing, 12px muted help line under the input; sections are a hairline rule (24 above) then a heading 18 below, never a framed group.
components.xaml:
<StackPanel Margin="24,22,24,24">

    <TextBlock Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="1" Classes="detail" Text="Клиенты будут качать патч с …" />
  </Grid>
  <Border Classes="rule" Margin="0,24,0,0" />
  <TextBlock Margin="0,18,0,0" Classes="heading" Text="Патч" />
</StackPanel>

<Style Selector="TextBlock.heading"><Setter Property="FontSize" Value="17" /><Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold" /><Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap" /></Style>
<Style Selector="TextBlock.heading.failed"><Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource FailedBrush}" /></Style>
<Style Selector="TextBlock.field"><Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource MutedBrush}" /><Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center" /></Style>

components.name: Choice List
components.description: A choice of few (delivery method) as catalog rows, not a dropdown; 12x10 rows, Selected Grey fill bleeding 12px into the gutter so text stays on the heading's edge; hairline below.
components.xaml:
<Border Margin="-12,14,-12,0" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource HairlineBrush}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
  <ListBox Classes="catalog choice" ItemsSource="{Binding Methods}" SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedMethod}" />
</Border>

components.name: Operation Progress, Failure and Log
components.description: Operation dialog: heading, state in muted tabular words, 4px Ink-on-Hairline progress bar; on failure the bar gives way to a 2px Failure Red box; the log is data, so monospace 12px on a flat Panel Grey field.
components.xaml:
<StackPanel Spacing="4">
  <TextBlock Classes="heading" Text="Сборка патча" />
  <TextBlock Classes="muted number" Text="Выполняется · 42 %" />
</StackPanel>
<ProgressBar Margin="0,14,0,0" Minimum="0" Maximum="100" Value="42" IsVisible="{Binding !IsFailed}" />
<Border Classes="failure" Margin="0,14,0,0" IsVisible="{Binding IsFailed}">
  <SelectableTextBlock TextWrapping="Wrap" Foreground="{DynamicResource FailedBrush}" Text="DownloadError: …" />
</Border>
<TextBox Classes="log" Margin="0,16,0,0" IsReadOnly="True" AcceptsReturn="True" TextWrapping="Wrap" />

components.name: Release Notes
components.description: «Что нового»: Title heading + muted subtitle («Обновлено до 2.0.1»), hairline, then releases newest first separated by hairlines. Version at 32px regular, tabular, -0.8 tracking (smaller echo of the display number); ### sections as Title; bullets as a Muted en dash in an 18px column; inline code Cascadia Mono 13px; text column max 640px; one primary «Закрыть». Rendered from docs/releases/X.Y.Z.md by Views/MarkdownView.
components.xaml:
<StackPanel Margin="32,24,32,0" Spacing="4">
  <TextBlock Classes="heading" Text="Что нового" />
  <TextBlock Classes="muted number" Text="Обновлено до 2.0.1" />
  <Border Classes="rule" Margin="0,16,0,0" />
</StackPanel>
<ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Notes}">
  <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
    <DataTemplate>
      <Border Classes="note"><v:MarkdownView Markdown="{Binding Markdown}" /></Border>
    </DataTemplate>
  </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
</ItemsControl>

<Style Selector="TextBlock.noteversion"><Setter Property="FontSize" Value="32" /><Setter Property="LetterSpacing" Value="-0.8" /></Style>
<Style Selector="Border.note"><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource HairlineBrush}" /><Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0,0,0,1" /><Setter Property="Padding" Value="0,0,0,18" /><Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,0,24" /></Style>
<Style Selector="ItemsControl ContentPresenter:nth-last-child(1) Border.note"><Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0" /><Setter Property="Margin" Value="0" /></Style>

narrative.overview:
The world borrows from a record-label catalog sleeve (Saville / Factory): a matte ground, hairline rules, ink type, and colour that appears only as code. Every version of an application is a catalog entry. Its state is a strip of square stage blocks per platform (Windows: Билд, Патч, Доставка, Проверка; Android: Билд, Подпись, Доставка, Проверка) read left to right: filled means done, a hairline outline means not yet, a heavy red outline means failed. The strip is always spelled out in words beside or inside it, so colour is never the only carrier of meaning.

The surface is a tool, not a showcase. Density is calm: one oversized version number per screen, one row of stage blocks, one primary ink button that names the next step, and a quiet label/value/action table under a hairline. Everything else is neutral grey on matte ground. Light and dark themes are the same world with the values inverted; stage colours are identical in both because they are code, not decoration.

Scope as built: every window is drawn in this world: the main window (start screen and project screen) and the dialogs (project settings, delivery, FTP connection, FTP browser, operation log, message and prompt), which share one dialog grammar (see Components → Dialogs).
keyCharacteristics: Matte neutral ground, ink type, hairline rules; no gradients, no shadows, no rounded corners.
Colour exists only as the five stage hues; state is encoded as fill (done), outline (pending), red outline (failed).
One display-size version number is the only headline; metadata sits beside it on the baseline.
One filled ink button per screen; every other action is a hairline-outlined quiet button or a menu item.
Every coded state is also written in Russian words («№ 5 · проверка не прошла»).

rules.name: The Colour Is Code Rule
rules.body: The five stage hues and the failure red appear only on stage blocks and stage chips (failure red also on the failure line and box that report a failed stage or operation). Text, buttons, panels, rules and selection stay neutral. The one exception is Build Blue as Fluent's accent inside stock inputs (see Components → Stock Chrome).

rules.name: The Same Code In Both Themes Rule
rules.body: Stage hues and Stage Ink do not change between light and dark; only neutrals and Failure Red adapt.

rules.name: The Spelled-Out Rule
rules.body: Every stage state shown in colour is also present as words: the block title and detail, the catalog line («новый · патч не собран»), and the tooltip («Проверка: не прошла …»).

rules.name: The One Big Number Rule
rules.body: The version number is the only display-size text on the project screen; platform and release number sit beside it on the baseline in muted body text, never above it.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any text that is a version, date, number or count uses tabular figures so catalog columns and dates align.

rules.name: The Single Strip Rule
rules.body: Stages render as one strip per platform track; never as a dashboard of equal cards spread across the screen. When a release carries two platforms, the strips stack (Windows first) and each gets a muted 14px caption above it, «Windows · проверка не прошла» / «Android · не проверялся»; with one platform there is no caption. In the catalog the chip strips stack the same way.

rules.name: The No Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow or floats. Hover and selection change fill (Selected Grey) or opacity, never elevation.

rules.name: The Still Catalog Rule
rules.body: No motion. State changes are instant: after an operation the catalog is rebuilt and the strip simply shows the new state, spelled out in words. Only Fluent's own control feedback (scrollbar expand, progress bar) moves.

dos: Do keep colour exclusively on stage blocks and chips: fill for done, 1px Pending outline for not yet, 2px Failure Red outline for failed.
Do spell out every coded state in Russian words next to or inside the colour («№ 5 · проверка не прошла»).
Do use one Ink primary button per screen whose label names the next step; put every other action in quiet hairline buttons or the menu.
Do use square corners (0) and 1px hairlines on every surface, including stock Fluent controls and every new window.
Do use tabular figures for versions, dates and counts.
Do keep stage hues and Stage Ink identical in light and dark themes.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients or rounded corners.
Don't use stage hues for buttons, links, headings, selection or decoration.
Don't mark selection with coloured bars or accent strips; selection is a Selected Grey fill.
Don't lay stages out as a dashboard of equal cards or actions as a row of equal buttons.
Don't place small uppercase labels above the display number or headings; the tracked caps label is only a list header in the left panel.
